slug.description: Stable short handle for this hypothesis, e.g. 'connection-pool-exhaustion'. Used to refer to it in prose and in other agents' output.

description.description: What is claimed to have gone wrong, in one or two sentences.

mechanism.description: The causal story: how this cause would produce the observed symptoms.

category.description: Which kind of change or condition this blames.

prior_confidence.description: The planner's orientation before investigation. 0.2 speculative, 0.4 plausible, 0.6 strong initial signal.

supporting_signals.description: The observations from context gathering that motivated this hypothesis.

investigate_by.description: What would confirm or refute it — the checks an investigator should run.

status.description: proposed by the planner, investigating while a child holds it, investigated once a causal chain exists, withdrawn if the investigator abandons it.

confidence.description: The investigator's own estimate after gathering evidence. The verifier's validated figure lives under review.confidence and supersedes this.

causal_chain.description: The ordered steps from root cause to observed symptom. Each step is a claim that stands on its own evidence.

step_id.description: Stable id for this step (s1, s2, ...). A review points at this, so it must not change when steps are reordered.

limitations.description: What this step could not establish, stated by the investigator rather than left for the reviewer to find.

evidence_id.description: Copied verbatim from the <evidence id="#ev-..."/> tag that follows a tool result you ran. Do not invent one.

description.description: What that result showed, in one line.

investigation_summary.description: The investigator's closing account of what it found and what it could not settle.

human_input_reasoning.description: Why a human is needed, and to decide what.

review.description: The verifier's verdict. Written only by the reviewing agent, which must not alter anything above it.

outcome.description: active: survives review. rejected: ruled out, and rejection_basis says on what.

confidence.description: The validated confidence. This supersedes the investigator's own.

is_primary.description: This is the root cause among the set reviewed. Exactly one hypothesis in a run carries true.

rejection_basis.description: Required when outcome is rejected: the specific evidence that rules it out.

needs_deeper_work.description: The chain is not wrong but is not established either — send it back for another investigation pass.

step_reviews.description: One entry per causal_chain step, judged independently.

limitation_gap.description: A gap the reviewer found that the investigator had not declared.

verification_evidence_id.description: The reviewer's own probe that settles this step.

falsification_attempts.description: Deliberate attempts to REFUTE the chain. Gathering more support is not falsification; a falsification attempt names the flaw it is hunting and runs a fresh probe for it.

falsification_target.description: The specific claim this probe tried to break.

limitation_resolution_attempts.description: Probes at the gaps the investigator declared.

uncovered_cause.description: Something the whole set fails to explain.

mitigations.description: Operational fixes for this hypothesis. Written only after it has been reviewed.

fix_type.description: immediate restores service now; permanent stops it recurring.

commands.description: Exact commands an operator would run.
